verified_facts.text: The hotel has a peaceful lakeside setting in Tu Liem Ward, Hanoi.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel offers a peaceful lakeside setting with convenient access to the city's business, convention, and cultural destinations

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits beside the Vietnam National Convention Center in western Hanoi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mễ Trì in western Hanoi, beside the Vietnam National Convention Center

verified_facts.text: The historic center is roughly a 30- to 40-minute drive from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The historic center is roughly a 30- to 40-minute drive away

verified_facts.text: The hotel was designed by architect Carlos Zapata.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel was designed by architect Carlos Zapata, whose striking cantilevered building takes inspiration from Vietnam's dramatic coastline and the image of a dragon rising beside the water

verified_facts.text: The cantilevered building takes inspiration from Vietnam's coastline and the image of a dragon rising beside the water.
verified_facts.excerpt: whose striking cantilevered building takes inspiration from Vietnam's dramatic coastline and the image of a dragon rising beside the water

verified_facts.text: The hotel's designs tell the legend of the Dragon (Lac Long Quan) and the Fairy (Au Co).
verified_facts.excerpt: let us tell a legendary story of the Dragon (Lạc Long Quân) and the Fairy (Âu Cơ) through brilliant designs

verified_facts.text: JW Lakeside Gardens is a spacious lakeside garden where guests may encounter birds and small animals.
verified_facts.excerpt: As you wander through the gardens, you may also encounter a variety of birds and small animals.

verified_facts.text: A horticulturist leads guests through the JW Greenhouse, JW Herb Garden and JW Animal Farm.
verified_facts.excerpt: Under the guidance of our horticulturist, guests will be walked through the JW Greenhouse, JW Herb Garden & JW Animal Farm

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a cooking class at JW Lakeside Gardens using herbs grown in the hotel's gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guided by our chefs, you'll learn to make some Vietnamese dishes by using the fresh, home-growth herbs from our gardens.

verified_facts.text: A coffee making class teaches guests to brew Vietnamese coffee with a phin filter.
verified_facts.excerpt: making yourself Vietnamese coffee by using Phin (Vietnamese coffee filter)

verified_facts.text: Wellbeing on 8 combines Spa L'Occitane en Provence, a fitness center and a suspended pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: We bring that expectation to life with a combination of Spa L'Occitane en Provence's treatments, facilities of the fitness center, and a beautiful suspended pool.

verified_facts.text: The indoor lap pool is suspended on the eighth floor beneath floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Suspended on the eighth floor beneath soaring floor-to-ceiling windows

verified_facts.text: Spa L'Occitane en Provence offers treatments including couples massages, facials and body wraps.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Body Wrap
Couples Massages
Eye Treatment
Facials

verified_facts.text: Balcony Rooms have a private balcony with views of the lake and the city skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step onto your private balcony and be captivated by sweeping panoramic views of the tranquil lake and the dynamic city skyline.

verified_facts.text: Every room features air purifiers, humidity control systems, automatic bidets and smart TVs with Netflix and YouTube streaming.
verified_facts.excerpt: every room features air purifiers, humidity control systems, automatic bidets, and smart TVs with Netflix and YouTube streaming

verified_facts.text: Suite guests enjoy Executive Lounge access and in-suite check-in.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy exclusive privileges including Executive Lounge access, in-suite check-in, a personalized welcome gift

verified_facts.text: French Grill serves modern French cuisine prepared in an open kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in exquisite modern French cuisine, artfully prepared in an open kitchen

verified_facts.text: Kids Cafe by JW on the 8th floor offers activities such as cookie decoration, statue painting and paper origami.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our children corner at Kids Café by JW also provide variety of activities as Cookie Decoration, Statue Painting, Paper Origami, Game Room

verified_facts.text: The hotel holds Green Globe Certification.
